title: Checkout failures: orders-api waiting on payment-api
symptoms: elevated p95 latency on the alerting service
circuit breaker or retry storms toward one dependency
read/connect timeouts naming a downstream host
observed_signals: retries increased request rate slightly without a user-traffic surge
db utilization rose only where the caller held connections during the wait
caller CPU and memory stayed close to baseline
downstream_latency_ms on the caller rose toward the configured client timeout

timeline.event: orders-api began retrying calls to payment-api
fallback served cached responses until payment-api recovered

contributing_factors: the caller had no fallback for that route
resolution: capped retries to stop amplifying load on payment-api
worked with the dependency owners on saturation of their pool
added synthetic checks against payment-api from the same region
lessons_learned: fallback and circuit breaking should be tested, not only documented
held DB connections during a slow downstream call are a side effect of waiting, not a saturated local pool
